note:
ALA-LC Khmer Romanization Table, 2013 version (earlier versions: October 2012, February 2012, 1997), pp. 1-4; held source interscript-private-references/alalc/alalc-khmer.pdf (the duplicate alalc-khmer.pdf.pdf is byte-identical, same sha256). Extraction: the PDF text layer is real Unicode text for the Latin romanization column (authoritative codepoints dumped per line), the consonant full forms, the diacritics-table marks, and the notes' Khmer marks and signs; the consonant SUBSCRIPT cells and the dependent table's two-part-vowel cells are shape-font lookalikes / PUA garbles. Every printed row was cross-checked against rendered page images (300 dpi pages, 600-900 dpi cell crops, 900 dpi re-crops for the ambiguous note-example clusters).
Correction table (text layer -> print): consonant subscript cells carry Latin-extended lookalikes (U+017E, U+017F, U+0180, ... plus control-range bytes) -> real coeng+consonant clusters, identified visually; dependent two-part vowel cells carry PUA U+F152 -> ោ, U+F153 -> ៅ, U+F155 -> ើ, U+021F (ȟ) -> ឿ, U+0222 (Ȣ) -> ៀ; note-example garbles: ƙ = ្រ, ƞ = ្ស, Ɨ = ្ម, ƛ/ƴ = ្វ/្ហ context-dependent, Ƹ = ច-with-vowel ligature, ȥ = ញ, ƃ = ្ច (shape-verified against the ច table cell), Ȧ = ្ញ, ƈ = ញ written as its own subscript with full-form lower element; the diacritics table's marks extract as real codepoints, the dot-above row's mark being ៱ = U+17F1 KHMER SYMBOL LEK ATTAK MUOY; the dependent table's leading mark (U+02B9 before every value, with row 1 showing open+close quotes around bare 'a') is list-quoting typography, not romanization (as the map description already records).
Findings (map-vs-source; transcribed rows EXCLUDED from the generated tests, never forced green; record for the maps-fix pipeline):
1. AA VOWEL (MAJOR): printed ◌ា = ā; the map's ា rules output plain a - កា -> ka (not kā), and ā survives only inside the Cាំ combos. Note 3's បា ligature -> pa (printed pā); Note 2's កញ្ញា (kaññā) example -> kañña; Note 5's អាត្ម័ន example loses the ā as well.
2. ឹ Y-DOT-ABOVE: printed ẏ (U+1E8F); the map encodes ỳ (U+1EF3, y-GRAVE) in the bare ឹ rule, CV (កឹ -> kỳ), ឹះ (kỳḥ) and the whole Note-4 form-change family (ងុឹ -> ng˝ỳ ...). The map's own ឿ rule uses ẏ (U+1E8F) - the encoding is internally inconsistent.
3. ឿ TRUNCATED: printed ẏa; the map outputs ẏ (bare ឿ and កឿ -> kẏ, missing the final a).
4. NIKAHIT: printed uṃ/aṃ/āṃ with ṃ (U+1E43, m-dot-below); the map encodes plain m in every nikahit row (ំ -> am, កំ -> kam, កាំ -> kām, កុំ -> kum).
5. oaḥ: printed េ◌ោះ = oaḥ with ḥ (U+1E25); the map's ោះ rule outputs plain h (កោះ -> koah), inconsistent with the map's own aḥ/iḥ/uḥ/eḥ rules which use proper ḥ.
6. ឪ: printed ýu (U+00FD, y-acute); the map encodes yu.
7. អ SERIES: the print's អ row romanization cell = ‛ ʹ "(ayn + soft sign)" (U+201B U+02B9) - bare-value reading ambiguous (the cell may demo the ៊-ed form); the map encodes bare អ -> ‛ and អ៊ -> ʹʹ (double prime, no ‛), the latter inconsistent with both the print and the map's own Note-4 form-change rule អុី -> ‛ʹī.
8. ៱ (dot-above row, U+17F1 KHMER SYMBOL LEK ATTAK MUOY; romanization ˙ U+02D9 per Note 5): no map rule at all; passes through.
9. ្ឡ COENG: the map's 34x34 coeng table encodes ឡ as a subscript (e.g. ក្ឡ -> kḷ) though the print gives ឡ no subscript form ("-"). The អ coeng omission matches the print (whose អ subscript cell demos the ៊-mark alternative form, not a subscript).
10. ៗ: print "romanized by repeating the preceding word or phrase"; the map placeholder "(repeat)" is kept as the existing encoding choice (lao round F7 class).
11. NOTE-6 SIGNS with no rules: X is romanized as a hyphen (-) - passes through as X; ៙ and ៚ are "omitted in romanization" - pass through unchanged.
12. NOTE-1 EXAMPLE ក្រកហ្វក់ (krakhvák): not letter-reproducible - letter-sequential composition gives krkahvák; the print places the inherent-vowel a after the subscript cluster (word-level rendering, not derivable from the row rules).
13. NOTE-2 EXAMPLE 1 is internally contradictory: the printed cluster's subscript shape-identifies as ្ច (matches the ច table cell; the ជ subscript's double-coil shape differs; the text layer shares the U+0183 garble) so the glyph reads ñc, while the parenthetical gloss reads (ñj) = the ញ្ជ value. The map composes both correctly (ញ្ច -> ñc, ញ្ជ -> ñj); neither reproduces the gloss from the printed glyph.
14. NOTE-5 EXAMPLE ក្សត្រីយ៍ (ksatriy˚): not letter-reproducible - composition gives kstrīya˚ (the print reads i where letter composition gives ī, and places an inherent a that composition does not produce).
15. NOTE-5 EXAMPLE ចា៎ះ (cāḥʼ): the C+ា+ះ combination has no map rule; character-order composition gives caʼaḥ (the print, per Note 5, places the kakabat's ʼ word-finally after the last letter).
16. NOTE-5 EXAMPLE អាត្ម័ន (‛ātmăn˙): runtime gives ‛atmăn; the print's trailing ˙ has no source sign in the word (print anomaly).
17. HARD/SOFT MARK ENCODING: the diacritics table prints ″ (U+2033) / ′ (U+2032); Note 4 itself prints ˝ (U+02DD) / ʹ (U+02B9). The map follows Note 4 - kept, table/note inconsistency recorded.
18. ALIF ENCODING: the diacritics table prints ’ (U+2019); Note 5 prints ʼ (U+02BC). The map follows Note 5 - kept, recorded.
19. NOTE-9 FORM យ + subscript ឱ (rendered ឱ + subscript យ, "oi, give"; alternative spelling with ឲ): no map rule (coeng+ឱ unencoded) - passes through. ឲ has no standalone table row ("never appears alone" per the print) - correctly absent.
Inventory notes: the ʻAksar Mul script columns (a separate script shown for every consonant row) share the romanization column and are not encodable in a Khmr->Latn map; the printed ◌◌់ and ◌ា◌់ rows are instantiated on ថ/ឆ (ថ់ -> áth, ឆាក់ -> châk) because the map's hand tests already carry the ក-instantiations (កក់ kák, កាក់ kâk); the Note-4 examples បុី p˝ī, សុី sʹī, មុន mun and the p4 examples កក kak, មក mak, សក sak are likewise the retained hand tests.
Bookkeeping: 155 rows transcribed; the rows array carries the 132 generated rows exactly (0 passing rows dropped as duplicates; 23 rows are the findings above, excluded from generation). Regenerating via scripts/gen-row-tests.mjs from this artifact reproduces the embedded block byte-for-byte.
